verses.text: Some time later, during wheat harvest, Samson came to visit his wife, bringing a young goat. He said, ‘I’m going into my wife’s room.’ But her father wouldn’t let him in. 🐐
Her father said, ‘I honestly thought you hated her, so I gave her to your companion. Isn’t her younger sister even prettier? Marry her instead.’ 🗣️
Samson told them, ‘This time, nobody can blame me for what I do to the Philistines.’ 😠
He went out and caught three hundred foxes. He tied them tail to tail, put a torch between each pair, 🦊
lit the torches, and let the foxes loose in the Philistines’ standing grain. The fire burned the grain stacks, the standing crops, and the olive groves. 🔥

The Philistines asked, ‘Who did this?’ They were told, ‘Samson, the Timnite’s son-in-law. His wife’s father gave her to Samson’s companion.’ So the Philistines went up and burned the woman and her father alive. 🔥
Samson said, ‘If that’s how you’re going to act, I’ll get even with you, and then I’ll stop.’ ⚠️
He attacked them with a terrible slaughter, then went down and stayed in a cave in Etam’s Rock. ⚔️
The Philistines moved into Judah, camped there, and spread out near Lehi. 🏕️
Judah’s men asked them, ‘Why have you come to fight us?’ They replied, ‘We’re here to tie Samson up and pay him back for what he did to us.’ 🗣️

Three thousand men from Judah went down to the cave at Etam’s Rock and told Samson, ‘Don’t you know the Philistines rule us? Why’d you bring this trouble on us?’ He answered, ‘I only did to them what they did to me.’ 😟
They said, ‘We came to tie you up and hand you over to the Philistines.’ Samson said, ‘Promise you won’t attack me yourselves.’ 🤝
They told him, ‘No. We’ll tie you up securely and hand you over, but we won’t kill you.’ They bound him with two new ropes and led him up from the rock. 🪢
When he reached Lehi, the Philistines came shouting to meet him. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came powerfully over him; the ropes on his arms went like burned flax, and his bindings fell away. 💥
He found a fresh donkey’s jawbone, reached out, grabbed it, and struck down a thousand men with it. 🫏
Samson said, ‘With a donkey’s jawbone, heaps on heaps! With a donkey’s jawbone, I struck down a thousand men.’ ⚔️
When he finished speaking, he threw the jawbone away. That place was named Ramath-Lehi. 🪨
Samson was extremely thirsty. He called to Yahweh: ‘You gave your servant this huge victory. Am I now going to die of thirst and fall into the hands of these uncircumcised people?’ 🙏
But God split open the hollow at Lehi, and water came out. Samson drank, regained his strength, and revived. That’s why the place is called En-Hakkore, at Lehi, to this day. 💧
Samson led Israel for twenty years while the Philistines ruled. ⏳
